futureDashboardSurfaces.snapshotUse: Read-only summary of customer-scoped businesses, territories, opportunities, confidence, operating profile context, and provenance.
Historical view of territory nodes, business relationships, inactive areas, repeated visits, and territory-level evidence.
Read-only pattern display for visits, outcomes, leads, follow-ups, successful evidence, and repeated behavior.
Relationship view connecting reps, visits, territories, outcomes, and learning provenance without changing assignments or CRM.
Read-only clusters of related businesses and opportunities using nearby, similar, recommended, converted, and successful relationships.
Display confidence band, evidence counts, source evidence, learned-at range, and human override state without activating confidence propagation.
Read-only operating-profile context for industry vocabulary, outcomes, evidence categories, and customer-specific learning provenance.

readOnlyDisplayPolicies: Display CustomerGraphSnapshot data as historical/read-only intelligence, never as an editable source of truth.
Do not mutate Dashboard state, CRM records, Active Pool records, route scoring, recommendations, assignments, or operating-profile definitions from snapshot displays.
Render confidence as explanation/provenance only; confidence propagation remains inactive until Intelligence explicitly authorizes it.
Show stale, missing, rejected, or cross-customer snapshot data as unavailable instead of synthesizing replacement graph facts.
Hide or summarize sensitive source evidence when the active user role does not need full provenance detail.
Preserve human override state and review state in every future detail view that presents graph-derived conclusions.
customerTenantIsolationRequirements: Every future Dashboard query must include active customerId and reject results whose customerId differs from the active tenant.
Every rendered node and relationship must carry the same customerId as the active Dashboard customer context.
Cached snapshots must be partitioned by customerId, operatingProfileId, snapshotVersion, and contractVersion.
No cross-customer rollups, comparisons, or cluster displays may be rendered from raw CustomerGraphSnapshots.
If tenant context is missing or ambiguous, Dashboard must render no graph data and surface an unavailable state.
Rep-facing views must remain scoped to authorized customer and role context even when Founder/Owner summaries exist.
explainabilityRequirements: Every future snapshot surface must answer why the insight is shown, what evidence supports it, how confident the system is, what changed, and what should happen next.
Dashboard must display source evidence counts, learned-at range, generatedBy, generatedAt, confidence band, and review/human override state where applicable.
Dashboard must distinguish verified evidence, reviewable evidence, stale evidence, missing evidence, and unavailable evidence.
Explanations must not expose proprietary scoring weights or imply that read-only snapshot confidence changed live recommendations.
Operating profile insights must name the active operatingProfileId and avoid hardcoded industry vocabulary when snapshot profile context exists.
futureActivationRequirements: Dashboard must receive CustomerGraphSnapshots with readOnly=true, queryIndex.readOnly=true, and matching contractVersion.
Dashboard must add runtime tests for customer isolation, read-only rendering, provenance display, confidence display, stale snapshot fallback, and route-scoring non-regression.
Dashboard must keep route scoring, Active Pool selection, CRM mutation, Mobile behavior, Website behavior, Companion behavior, Infrastructure, and Intelligence Engine behavior unchanged.
Dashboard must pass production release gates before any CustomerGraphSnapshot surface becomes visible.
